messages:
cass: Postmortem follow-up: yesterday's canary didn't auto-rollback; blast radius reached ~20% of traffic. Need owners + short timelines for fixes.

mira: Key failures: feature-flag timeouts and slow metric aggregation. We missed the initial spike because our canary metric window is 60s.

eli: Proposal: add a 10s fast-path metric for canaries and a local flag fallback in the controller (treat missing flag as OFF after N failures). I'll draft a small change.

samira: I'll own alerts and dry-run. Plan: add canary_fast_error_rate alert (10s buckets) and a synthetic dry-run in staging. ETA: 48h.

eli: I'll PR controller fallback + circuit-breaker for flag service and emit "flag_lookup_health" metric. Target PR in 2 days.

mira: Also add rollout params: max_percentage and max_customers so blast radius is limited. Who owns schema migration?

samira: I can coordinate with infra for migration scripts. ETA for rollout fields: 10 days with migration.

ops_oncall: Oncall will validate alert thresholds during staging dry-run. Schedule looks good.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary-controller v0.9.3 -> staging

cass: Action items I'll add to RI-4601:
- samira: alerts + staging dry-run (48h)
- eli: controller fallback PR + metrics (2d)
- samira/infra: rollout schema + migration (10d)
- ops_oncall: validate dry-run and rollback invocation

mira: Thanks. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and a monthly "canary blast-radius audit" recurring ticket. Ping in 48h for status.
